profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced engineer with 7+ years turning ambiguous product challenges into scalable systems. Recognized top performer specializing in risk assessment, full-scope edge case discovery, and cross-team execution.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Risk Assessment & Engineering Quality: Recognized as the team lead for risk assessment and detail-oriented technical analysis; broke down complex feature requests to uncover edge cases, defined full scope, and prevent production bottlenecks prior to execution.
-Accessibility Leadership: Consulted across multiple engineering pods to analyze systems, identified compliance gaps, and established web accessibility (A11y/WCAG) standards to elevate product inclusivity.
-Architecture & Cross-Functional Scoping: Spearheaded technical architecture and backlog refinement in close partnership with Product and UI/UX Design to align on full feature scopes and end-to-end user journeys.
-Full-Stack Engineering: Architected enterprise web applications using C#, ASP.NET, Blazor, React, and TypeScript, while managing backend schemas on SQL Server.
-Modular Infrastructure & CI/CD: Deployed versioned NuGet packages via custom Azure DevOps pipeline scripts, leveraging Dependency Injection to ensure modular, unit-tested architectures.
-AI Productivity: Leveraged GitHub Copilot and Gemini to accelerate component building, pipeline scripting, and technical documentation.
-Observability & Recognition: Monitored platform health via App Insights, mentored incoming engineers, and maintained annual Top Performer status for high-rigor delivery and quality leadership.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Blazor · TypeScript · JavaScript · ASP.NET MVC · GitHub · Microsoft SQL Server · Microsoft Copilot · Accessibility Testing · Solution Architecture · Google Gemini · Langfuse · Presidio · DevOps · KnockoutJS

positions.title: Quality Assurance Support
positions.description:
-Test Automation & Optimization: Led the migration of end-to-end testing suites from Behat to Cypress, significantly improving test execution speed and reliability.
-Quality Assurance Strategy: Wrote, executed, and maintained automated test scripts (Selenium, Cypress) in parallel with active sprint development cycles.
-Client Support & Resolution: Responded to high-priority client support tickets within tight SLAs, identifying root causes and collaborating with engineering to deliver bug fixes.
-Sprint Execution: Supported cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, delivering ad-hoc development tasks to consistently hit release deadlines.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Assurance · Quality Assurance Testing · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Microservices & Backend: Engineered modular microservices using C# and ASP.NET MVC, ensuring high system availability and seamless third-party service integration.
-Frontend Development: Built interactive, responsive web interfaces using JavaScript, Knockout.js, jQuery, and Kendo UI to improve user engagement and site functionality.
-Support & Maintenance: Handled tier-three application support on a monthly rotation, directly troubleshooting customer-reported bugs and maintaining legacy system versions.
-Agile & Delivery: Managed user stories and tickets in Azure DevOps
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · JavaScript · jQuery · Kendo Ui · KnockoutJS · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Frontend Architecture: Built dynamic web components using React.js and Redux based on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) for high-visibility Life Insurance microsites.
-API Testing & Integration: Integrated backend endpoints and validated HTTP method responses using Postman to ensure seamless client-server data flow.
-Automated Testing & Coverage: Created comprehensive unit test suites using Enzyme and Sinon, driving up overall code coverage and application reliability.
-Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinated feature releases between onshore and offshore engineering teams, defect tracking via ALM, and live stakeholder demos.
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Postman API · Enzyme Test · Sinon · React.js · Redux.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-EST API & Microservices: Developed and exposed RESTful services using Express.js and Node.js, integrating asynchronous database calls for dynamic JSON payloads.
-Database Management: Configured and queried PostgreSQL databases, creating optimized schemas to support add, update, and delete operations.
-UI & Client-Side Logic: Designed responsive web pages with Bootstrap, TypeScript, jQuery, and SurveyJS utilizing two-way data binding for complex user input forms.
-Unit Testing & CI/CD: Wrote automated unit tests using Jest and Mockito, leveraging Git and Trello for pipeline tracking and code versioning.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · jQuery · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · SurveyJs · Jest · Mockito · Microservices

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
-Student Mentorship: Tutor and guide students in core Java programming concepts, object-oriented design, and debugging strategies.
-Curriculum Delivery: Prepare and deliver structured lesson plans, coding exercises, and instructional materials aligned with course objectives.
-Lab Facilitation: Lead interactive evening lab sessions to reinforce lecture topics and support students through hands-on coding challenges.

projects.title: Project Polaris
projects.description: The new AI-powered version of Everway’s Polaris platform is an enterprise-grade generative AI solution designed to automate the Individualized Education Program (IEP) lifecycle. Built within a secure, closed data ecosystem to ensure strict student privacy compliance, the platform utilizes grounded AI models to ingest raw assessment data and instantly generate personalized, state-aligned SMART goals and detailed Present Levels (PLAAF) statements. Additionally, it features an advanced bulk PDF parser that extracts and migrates legacy student records into actionable digital formats, effectively cutting administrative paperwork time for educators by 50%.

projects.title: Schedule On Demand
projects.description: This project allows teachers, service providers, parents, and caregivers to manually advance events and strategies on the positivity schedule to match their individual needs.
